Liiga game team stats

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_game_team_stats.Rd

One game's per-period team stats with puck possession.

Usage

liiga_game_team_stats(season, game_id)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Game ids repeat across seasons, so a game is (season, game_id).

game_id

Game id (game_id in liiga_schedule or liiga_games), e.g. 1; unique only within a season.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (22 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
game_idintegerGame id, unique only within a season: key a game as (season, game_id).
sidecharacterWhich team of the game the row belongs to: home or away.
periodintegerPeriod number: 1-3 are regulation, 4 and up overtime (or the shootout).
team_idintegerTeam id, the number of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key (sent as that string, a bare integer or a digit string depending on the route).
team_slugcharacterTeam slug, the part of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key after the colon (e.g. hpk).
goalsintegerGoals (team, this period).
shotsintegerShots (team, this period).
power_play_instancescharacterJSON list of Liiga's codes for the team's power plays in the period, one per power play (code meaning undocumented).
power_play_goalsintegerPower play goals (team, this period).
short_handed_instancescharacterJSON list of Liiga's codes for the team's short-handed spells in the period, one per spell (code meaning undocumented).
short_handed_goals_againstintegerShort handed goals against (team, this period).
penalty_minutesintegerPenalty minutes (team, this period).
face_off_winsintegerFace off wins (team, this period).
two_minute_penaltiesintegerTwo minute penalties (team, this period).
five_minute_penaltiesintegerFive minute penalties (team, this period).
ten_minute_penaltiesintegerTen minute penalties (team, this period).
twenty_minute_penaltiesintegerTwenty minute penalties (team, this period).
total_distance_travellednumericDistance skated by the team in the period (unit not stated).
puck_control_durationnumericSeconds this team controlled the puck in the period.
opponent_puck_control_durationnumericSeconds the other team controlled the puck in the period.
contested_control_durationnumericSeconds the puck was contested in the period.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games/stats/{season}/{game_id}

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()
